label: Copy
depicts: Two overlapping document sheets with two short text bars on the front page
use_when: Use when the interface wants duplicated pages and the front sheet visibly carries text bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for blank or dashed copy icons when the front page text bars should remain visible.

label: Copy
depicts: Two overlapping square document panels with a blank front sheet
use_when: Use when the interface wants duplicated page panels without text lines or dashed edges.
avoid_when: Do not use for the text bar or dashed selection variants when the front sheet should stay blank.

label: Copy
depicts: Square document panel with a dashed duplicate frame floating at the upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a copy symbol that emphasizes a dashed duplicate frame instead of stacked sheets.
avoid_when: Do not use for the overlapping page copies when the dashed outer frame is the main cue.

label: Document
depicts: Single document sheet with two short horizontal text bars centered inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants one plain document page with two centered text bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for folded corner documents when the top edge should stay flat and plain.

label: Document
depicts: Document sheet with a folded top right corner one dot and one short text bar
use_when: Use when the interface wants a single page with a visible folded corner and mixed line dot marks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain page when the folded corner should remain part of the form.
